scope: Post-hoc final report analysis of frozen twenty targets; no model calls or retuning

method.interval: 2.5/97.5 linear percentiles of paired cluster bootstrap corpus-WER differences in percentage points
method.multiplicity: Exploratory intervals, no simultaneous coverage or confirmatory p-values
method.caution: Zero-width interval for identical observed errors does not establish population equivalence

limitations: Small fixed selection from MELD train, not official test
Visual success is parser completion, not verified semantic accuracy
Subgroups were analyzed after outcomes; descriptive sensitivity only
Same show; clusters may retain cross-episode dependence
